messages.author: ccc901fb8bb16d15
messages.subject: Use of external libraries
parts:
Hi. I'm totally new to R and Renjin. Right now i'm working on a proyect in Java, but the team need to run some R scripts, so i decided to use Rengin. I read on a post:

"If your packages include C or Fortran code, you will need to do some work to get them running on the JVM/Renjin. It looks like BBMLE is pure R and hyp2f1zhangjin has only some very straightforward fortran code, so it should be possible to convert to byte code using gcc-bridge. I will take a look at tonight and post some better docs on using packages. Is your project using maven? "

I've been looking for how to do this "convert to byte code using gcc-bridge", and i was wondering if you could help me. that would be great.

Thanks for the help!

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Use of external libraries
parts:
Hi Ernesto,

You might first take a look at packages.renjin.org to see if the packages you need are already compiled- they are available as maven artifacts from our repository. If not, you can take a look at how the maven-renjin-plugin is used by Renjin itself to compile, for example, the stats package to JVM byte code:

https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/blob/master/packages/stats/pom.xml

HTH,

Alex
